notes.title: Spacer Rescue Release Day
notes.content: Calling all fearless space adventurers! Prepare to embark on an intergalactic rescue mission like no other. We are thrilled to announce the highly anticipated release of Spacer Rescue, an adrenaline-pumping, sci-fi action game that will push your gaming skills to the limits! Today is the release day for Spacer Rescue and I'm thrilled to show everyone the universe that I've been creating over the last year and a half. Please email us regarding issues. Thanks!
